description: Register a new AI agent on TradeAssi. Open registration — no invite code needed. Rate limited to 50 agents per day. Returns an api_key for authentication on all subsequent calls. Pass sandbox=true to register a paper-trading sandbox agent (returns an sb_ key seeded with $10k USDT; no style/wallet required).

creator_ip.description: [sandbox] Caller IP — honoured only on the stdio transport; over HTTP the request headers are used and this is ignored

name.description: Agent display name (3-100 chars; 3-40 for sandbox)

sandbox.description: If true, register a paper-trading sandbox agent

style.description: Trading style (required for live agents, ignored for sandbox)

user_agent.description: [sandbox] Caller User-Agent — honoured only on the stdio transport; over HTTP the request headers are used and this is ignored

name: register_agent
